psalm-28-1.verse: To You, O Lord, I call; My rock, do not be deaf to me, For if You are silent to me, I will become like those who go down to the pit.
psalm-28-1.prayer: Lord, You are my rock and my refuge. When I call to You, hear my prayer and help me trust that You are listening.

psalm-28-2.verse: Hear the voice of my supplications when I cry to You for help, When I lift up my hands toward Your holy sanctuary.
psalm-28-2.prayer: Father, I lift my hands and my heart toward You. Thank You for inviting me into Your presence and hearing my cries for mercy.

psalm-28-3.verse: Do not drag me away with the wicked And with those who work iniquity, Who speak peace with their neighbors, While evil is in their hearts.
psalm-28-3.prayer: Lord, keep me from being influenced by evil or hypocrisy. Help me walk in sincerity, truth, and integrity before You.

psalm-28-4.verse: Requite them according to their work and according to the evil of their practices; Requite them according to the deeds of their hands; Repay them their recompense.
psalm-28-4.prayer: Father, You are perfectly just. Help me trust Your judgment and leave every matter in Your hands rather than seeking my own revenge.

psalm-28-5.verse: Because they do not regard the works of the Lord Nor the deeds of His hands, He will tear them down and not build them up.
psalm-28-5.prayer: Lord, open my eyes to recognize Your works and Your hand in my life. Help me appreciate Your wisdom, power, and faithfulness.

psalm-28-6.verse: Blessed be the Lord, Because He has heard the voice of my supplication.
psalm-28-6.prayer: Father, thank You for hearing my prayers. Fill my heart with gratitude as I remember how You have answered and sustained me.

psalm-28-7.verse: The Lord is my strength and my shield; My heart trusts in Him, and I am helped; Therefore my heart exults, And with my song I shall thank Him.
psalm-28-7.prayer: Lord, You are my strength and my shield. Help me trust You completely and rejoice in the protection and peace You provide.

psalm-28-8.verse: The Lord is their strength, And He is a saving defense to His anointed.
psalm-28-8.prayer: Father, thank You for being the strength of Your people. Encourage and sustain all who place their hope in You.

psalm-28-9.verse: Save Your people and bless Your inheritance; Be their shepherd also, and carry them forever.
psalm-28-9.prayer: Lord, bless and shepherd Your people. Guide us with Your wisdom, carry us through every season, and keep us close to You.

psalm-28-closing.verse:
Lord, thank You for being my rock, my strength, and my shield. Thank You for hearing my prayers and surrounding me with Your protection. Help me trust You completely, walk in integrity, and rest in Your faithfulness. Shepherd my life according to Your will, strengthen my faith, and fill my heart with praise for all You have done and all You will do.

In Jesus’ name, Amen. 🙏🏻
